spec.objective: Add a new pure, stdlib+ngv2-only module ngv2/huntr_submission.py that renders the proven legacy huntr submission shape — a {ID}_submission.md Markdown document carrying the ten canonical huntr form fields plus a reference to the companion {ID}_poc.js Node.js PoC file — by mapping the existing build_submission_package body onto the huntr field layout. functional_requirements: Define HUNTR_FIELDS as a tuple of (heading, context-key) pairs in the canonical order: Repository, Package Manager, Version Affected, Vulnerability Type / CWE, CVSS, Title, Description, Impact, Occurrences, References; and PLACEHOLDER = '_Not provided_'.

render_huntr_fields(context) renders the ten fields as numbered '### {idx}. {heading}' Markdown sections, substituting PLACEHOLDER when the context value is None or empty string, terminating with a single trailing newline.

build_huntr_submission(submission_id, finding, poc, live_report, bounty=None) builds the context dict mapping finding/poc/live_report/bounty onto the ten fields and returns a '# {submission_id}: {title}' header followed by render_huntr_fields output.

The Description field is built by _render_description: call build_submission_package(finding, poc, live_report) then append '

### Proof of Concept

See companion file `{ID}_poc.js` (Node.js) for the runnable PoC.'.
CVSS rendering (_render_cvss) handles a Mapping with 'vector'/'score' keys (emitting '- Vector: ...' and '- **Score: ...**' lines), a scalar value via _text, and None/empty -> PLACEHOLDER.

Occurrences and References rendering (_render_occurrences/_render_references) handle a list (bulleted, dropping blank entries), a single str/bytes, a scalar, and None/empty -> PLACEHOLDER; occurrences falls back from finding['occurrences'] to finding['permalinks'].

Vulnerability Type / CWE is composed by joining vuln_type (finding.vuln_type or category) and cwe (finding.cwe or category) with ' / ', and repo_url/package_manager/version_affected are resolved with the documented bounty-vs-finding precedence; all missing values degrade to PLACEHOLDER without raising and with no network/subprocess/LLM/clock/randomness.

Consumes ngv2.submission_package.build_submission_package(finding, poc, live_report) -> str.
edge_cases: finding/poc/live_report/bounty passed as None must be coerced to empty dicts (`x or {}`) so .get never raises.
Empty-string and None values for any field render as PLACEHOLDER rather than appearing blank or raising.
CVSS given as a Mapping with only a vector or only a score must render just the present line(s); an empty Mapping degrades to PLACEHOLDER.
occurrences/references given as a single string must render as one bullet, not be iterated character-by-character.
List occurrences/references containing None or whitespace-only entries must have those entries dropped.
When both vuln_type and cwe are missing, Vulnerability Type / CWE degrades to PLACEHOLDER (join of empty -> None -> placeholder).

```python
Pins the proven legacy huntr submission shape: a {ID}_submission.md document

"""
from ngv2.huntr_submission import (
    build_huntr_submission,
    poc_js_filename,
    HUNTR_FIELDS,
    PLACEHOLDER,
)

TEN_FIELDS = (
    'Repository',
    'Package Manager',
    'Version Affected',
    'Vulnerability Type / CWE',
    'CVSS',
    'Title',
    'Description',
    'Impact',
    'Occurrences',
    'References',
)

SUB_ID = 'DVC-1'
BOUNTY = {
    'repo_url': 'https://github.com/iterative/dvc',
    'package_manager': 'pypi',
}
FINDING = {
    'title': 'Arbitrary File Write via Path Traversal',
    'cwe': 'CWE-22',
    'vuln_type': 'Path Traversal',
    'version_affected': 'latest (3.18.x)',
    'cvss': {'vector': 'AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:L', 'score': 9.0},
    'description': 'Unvalidated relpath split enables traversal.',
    'impact': 'Arbitrary file write -> code execution.',
    'occurrences': [
        'https://github.com/iterative/dvc/blob/abc123/tree.py#L171',
        'https://github.com/iterative/dvc/blob/abc123/checkout.py#L88',
    ],
    'references': ['https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/22.html'],
}
POC = {'script': 'DVC-1_poc.js', 'command': 'node DVC-1_poc.js'}
LIVE = {'status': 'confirmed', 'observed': 'file written outside repo'}


def test_poc_js_filename_matches_id():
    assert poc_js_filename('DVC-1') == 'DVC-1_poc.js'


def test_field_table_has_exactly_ten_fields_in_order():

    assert len(HUNTR_FIELDS) == 10


def test_rendered_package_contains_all_ten_huntr_fields():

    assert 'CWE-22' in pkg                                     # cwe

    assert '9.0' in pkg                                        # cvss score
    assert 'Arbitrary File Write' in pkg                       # title
    assert 'code execution' in pkg                             # impact
    assert 'tree.py#L171' in pkg                               # occurrence permalink
    assert 'cwe.mitre.org' in pkg                              # references
```

```python
"""Hand-authored wired oracle for ngv2/submission_package.py.

Replaces the blocked machine-authored sibling task
``submission-package-authored-tests``.

Pinned contract (from the blocked task spec):

``build_submission_package(finding, poc, live_report) -> str`` renders a
Markdown package containing all NINE canonical sections, in order:

    Title, CWE, Severity, Vulnerable Code References, Attack Scenario,
    PoC Reference, Live-Test Evidence, Impact, Suggested Fix

Routing: ``finding`` feeds title/cwe/severity/code-refs/attack-scenario/
impact/fix; ``poc`` feeds ONLY the PoC Reference section; ``live_report``
feeds ONLY the Live-Test Evidence section (sentinels must not leak across
sections). Missing keys degrade to a placeholder and never raise.
"""
import pytest

from ngv2.submission_package import build_submission_package, PLACEHOLDER

NINE_SECTIONS = (
    "Title",
    "CWE",
    "Severity",
    "Vulnerable Code References",
    "Attack Scenario",
    "PoC Reference",
    "Live-Test Evidence",
    "Impact",
    "Suggested Fix",
)

FINDING = {
    "title": "FINDING_TITLE_SENTINEL",
    "cwe": "CWE-78",
    "severity": "FINDING_SEVERITY_SENTINEL",
    "code_refs": ["FINDING_REF_SENTINEL"],
    "attack_scenario": "FINDING_SCENARIO_SENTINEL",
    "impact": "FINDING_IMPACT_SENTINEL",
    "fix": "FINDING_FIX_SENTINEL",
}
POC = {
    "script": "POC_SCRIPT_SENTINEL.py",
    "command": "POC_COMMAND_SENTINEL",
    "expected_output": "POC_EXPECTED_SENTINEL",
}
LIVE = {
    "status": "LIVE_STATUS_SENTINEL",
    "observed": "LIVE_OBSERVED_SENTINEL",
    "output": "LIVE_OUTPUT_SENTINEL",
}


def _sections(package: str) -> dict:
    """Split rendered Markdown into {section header: body} (## headings)."""
    sections = {}
    current = None
    for line in package.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("## "):
            current = line[3:].strip()
            sections[current] = []
        elif current is not None:
            sections[current].append(line)
    return {k: "\n".join(v) for k, v in sections.items()}


# ------------------------------------------------------ section completeness

def test_all_nine_sections_present_and_ordered():
    package = build_submission_package(FINDING, POC, LIVE)
    indices = []
    for header in NINE_SECTIONS:
        needle = "## " + header
        assert needle in package, f"missing section header: {header}"
        indices.append(package.index(needle))
    assert indices == sorted(indices), "sections out of canonical order"


def test_exactly_nine_canonical_sections_parsed():
    package = build_submission_package(FINDING, POC, LIVE)
    parsed = _sections(package)
    for header in NINE_SECTIONS:
        assert header in parsed


# ----------------------------------------------------------- source routing

def test_finding_fields_routed_to_their_sections():
    parsed = _sections(build_submission_package(FINDING, POC, LIVE))
    assert "FINDING_TITLE_SENTINEL" in parsed["Title"]
    assert "CWE-78" in parsed["CWE"]
    assert "FINDING_SEVERITY_SENTINEL" in parsed["Severity"]
    assert "FINDING_REF_SENTINEL" in parsed["Vulnerable Code References"]
    assert "FINDING_SCENARIO_SENTINEL" in parsed["Attack Scenario"]
    assert "FINDING_IMPACT_SENTINEL" in parsed["Impact"]
    assert "FINDING_FIX_SENTINEL" in parsed["Suggested Fix"]


def test_poc_sentinels_only_in_poc_reference_section():
    parsed = _sections(build_submission_package(FINDING, POC, LIVE))
    poc_body = parsed["PoC Reference"]
    assert "POC_SCRIPT_SENTINEL" in poc_body
    assert "POC_COMMAND_SENTINEL" in poc_body
    for header, body in parsed.items():
        if header == "PoC Reference":
            continue
        assert "POC_SCRIPT_SENTINEL" not in body, f"PoC leaked into {header}"
        assert "POC_COMMAND_SENTINEL" not in body, f"PoC leaked into {header}"


def test_live_sentinels_only_in_live_test_evidence_section():
    parsed = _sections(build_submission_package(FINDING, POC, LIVE))
    live_body = parsed["Live-Test Evidence"]
    assert "LIVE_STATUS_SENTINEL" in live_body
    assert "LIVE_OUTPUT_SENTINEL" in live_body
    for header, body in parsed.items():
        if header == "Live-Test Evidence":
            continue
        assert "LIVE_STATUS_SENTINEL" not in body, f"live leaked into {header}"
        assert "LIVE_OUTPUT_SENTINEL" not in body, f"live leaked into {header}"


def test_poc_content_not_sourced_from_finding():
    # A PoC-shaped key on the FINDING dict must not populate PoC Reference.
    finding = dict(FINDING)
    finding["script"] = "WRONG_SOURCE_SENTINEL"
    parsed = _sections(build_submission_package(finding, {}, LIVE))
    assert "WRONG_SOURCE_SENTINEL" not in parsed["PoC Reference"]
    assert PLACEHOLDER in parsed["PoC Reference"]


# ------------------------------------------------------ graceful degradation

def test_empty_inputs_produce_placeholders_not_errors():
    package = build_submission_package({}, {}, {})
    parsed = _sections(package)
    for header in NINE_SECTIONS:
        assert PLACEHOLDER in parsed[header], (
            f"section {header} lacks placeholder on empty input")


def test_none_inputs_do_not_raise():
    package = build_submission_package(None, None, None)
    for header in NINE_SECTIONS:
        assert "## " + header in package


def test_missing_finding_severity_does_not_raise():
    finding = {k: v for k, v in FINDING.items() if k != "severity"}
    parsed = _sections(build_submission_package(finding, POC, LIVE))
    assert PLACEHOLDER in parsed["Severity"]
    assert "FINDING_TITLE_SENTINEL" in parsed["Title"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("drop", ["title", "cwe", "attack_scenario",
                                  "impact", "fix", "code_refs"])
def test_each_missing_finding_key_degrades_to_placeholder(drop):
    finding = {k: v for k, v in FINDING.items() if k != drop}
    package = build_submission_package(finding, POC, LIVE)
    for header in NINE_SECTIONS:
        assert "## " + header in package


def test_section_count_invariant_across_field_subsets():
    # Property-style sweep: any subset of finding keys keeps all 9 sections.
    keys = list(FINDING)
    for i in range(len(keys) + 1):
        finding = {k: FINDING[k] for k in keys[:i]}
        package = build_submission_package(finding, {}, {})
        assert sum(
            1 for h in NINE_SECTIONS if ("## " + h) in package) == 9


def test_returns_string():
    assert isinstance(build_submission_package(FINDING, POC, LIVE), str)
```

"""Tests for the submission report template loader and field renderer."""
from __future__ import annotations
import os
from ngv2 import submission_package as sp
REQUIRED_HEADERS = ['Title', 'CWE', 'Severity', 'Vulnerable Code References', 'Attack Scenario', 'PoC Reference', 'Live-Test Evidence', 'Impact', 'Suggested Fix']
ALL_FIELD_NAMES = [name for _, name in sp.SECTION_LAYOUT]

def _full_field_set() -> dict:
    return {name: 'value-for-' + name for name in ALL_FIELD_NAMES}

def test_load_template_reads_legacy_path_when_present(tmp_path):
    contents = '# Custom Template\n{{title}}\n'
    template_file = tmp_path / 'submission_report_template.md'
    template_file.write_text(contents, encoding='utf-8')
    result = sp.load_submission_template(str(template_file))
    assert result == contents

def test_load_template_falls_back_to_default_when_missing(tmp_path):
    missing = tmp_path / 'does_not_exist.md'
    assert not missing.exists()
    result = sp.load_submission_template(str(missing))
    assert result == sp.DEFAULT_TEMPLATE
    for header in REQUIRED_HEADERS:
        assert header in result

def test_default_template_contains_all_nine_section_headers():
    template = sp.DEFAULT_TEMPLATE
    indices = []
    for header in REQUIRED_HEADERS:
        marker = '## ' + header
        assert marker in template
        indices.append(template.index(marker))
    assert indices == sorted(indices), 'headers must appear in required order'
    assert len(REQUIRED_HEADERS) == 9

def test_render_template_substitutes_named_placeholders():
    template = 'Name: {{title}} / Class: {{cwe}}'
    fields = {'title': 'Path Traversal', 'cwe': 'CWE-22'}
    result = sp.render_template(template, fields)
    assert result == 'Name: Path Traversal / Class: CWE-22'
    assert '{{' not in result

def test_render_template_marks_missing_fields():
    template = 'T: {{title}} S: {{severity}}'
    fields = {'title': 'Only title'}
    result = sp.render_template(template, fields)
    assert 'Only title' in result
    assert sp.NOT_PROVIDED_MARKER in result
    empty_result = sp.render_template('{{impact}}', {'impact': '   '})
    assert empty_result == sp.NOT_PROVIDED_MARKER

def test_loaded_template_renders_cleanly_with_full_field_set(tmp_path):
    template = sp.load_submission_template(str(tmp_path / 'missing.md'))
    rendered = sp.render_template(template, _full_field_set())
    assert '{{' not in rendered and '}}' not in rendered
    assert sp.NOT_PROVIDED_MARKER not in rendered
    for name in ALL_FIELD_NAMES:
        assert 'value-for-' + name in rendered

def test_render_template_never_leaves_unsubstituted_placeholder_for_known_fields():
    template = sp.DEFAULT_TEMPLATE
    field_sets = [_full_field_set(), {name: str(i) for i, name in enumerate(ALL_FIELD_NAMES)}, {ALL_FIELD_NAMES[0]: 'x'}, {}]
    for fields in field_sets:
        rendered = sp.render_template(template, fields)
        assert '{{' not in rendered
        assert '}}' not in rendered

def test_extra_fields_are_ignored_not_appended():
    template = 'Only: {{title}}'
    fields = {'title': 'Kept', 'unreferenced_field': 'should-not-appear', 'another_extra': 'also-ignored'}
    result = sp.render_template(template, fields)
    assert result == 'Only: Kept'
    assert 'should-not-appear' not in result
    assert 'also-ignored' not in result
